method: Three diagnostic colonies; 20 paired random phases per colony. Pooled bout summaries are descriptive; phases reuse the same colony and are not independent colony replicates.

inputs.geometry: post-step in-nest mouthContact, uninterrupted, sampled at dt; no gap merging
inputs.direction: only one flow direction in the whole mouth episode; no-flow, reversing or incomplete episodes excluded and counted
inputs.duration: raw mouth episode minus flow bout; observed occupied scan bins = scan count * 60 s; event span = (last - first scan minute) * 60 s
